verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some documented API surfaces of Auth0's own. The My Organization API supports custom in-app administrative experiences, and documented OAuth endpoints (client credentials, device authorization) issue tokens to programmatic clients. However, no general tenant-management API is explicitly documented in the pack, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path; the CLI, MCP server and Terraform module are separate interfaces and earn no credit here. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a comprehensive public management API, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via API.
